title: Topic 1: People Description
prompts: Talk about your best friend.
- What is his/her name?
- What is he/she like? (Appearance?)
- What are his/her personality, quality and ability?
- What does he/she like doing?
- And say what he/she would like to do in the future.
sampleAnswer: My best friend's name is Nam. He is tall and well-built with short black hair and a bright smile. He is a very friendly, honest, and helpful person. He is also very smart and good at solving problems. In his free time, he likes playing football and reading books. In the future, he would like to become a successful software engineer because he loves technology.

title: Topic 2: Free time, leisure and hobby
prompts: Talk about your daily routine.
- What do you often do on weekdays?
- What time do you get up?
- What time and how do you go to work/school?
- What time do you finish your work/study?
- And say what you often do at the weekend.
sampleAnswer: On weekdays, I go to work in the morning and finish at 5:30 p.m. In the evening, I usually use my phone. I go to bed at 10:00 p.m. On weekends, I often go fishing or just stay at home to relax and listen to music.

title: Topic 3: Sports
prompts: Talk about benefits of playing sports.
- How can sport improve your physical health?
- How can sport improve your mental health?
- How can sport improve your social life?
sampleAnswer:
I usually play football with my friends three times a week after school. Sometimes, I play pickeball at the weekend.

I play sports because it helps me stay healthy and relax after studying. It is also a fun way to spend time with my friends.

Playing sports improves my physical health in many ways. It helps me become stronger and keeps me fit.

Sports are also good for my mental health. When I feel stressed or tired, playing sports helps me relax and feel happier.

In addition, sports improve my social life. I can meet new people and make more friends.

title: Topic 4: Work and jobs
prompts: Talk about your future plans.
- What job do you plan to do in the future?
- Why do you choose that job?
- What do you do to get that job?
- And say what difficulties you meet about your plans.
sampleAnswer:
After I finish university, I plan to become an IT technician. I want to work with computers and technology.

I choose this job because I'm very interested in computers. I love solving problems with technology and learning new things about how they work.

To get this job, I need to study very hard at university. Maybe I will also try to do an internship to get some real work experience.

Of course, I think there will be some difficulties. The biggest challenge might be finding a good job right after graduation because many students want to work in IT.

title: Topic 5: House and home
prompts: Talk about your favourite room in your house.
- Which is your favourite room in your house? Why?
- What does it look like?
- What changes do you want to make in it?
sampleAnswer:
My house is a two-story house with five rooms: a living room, a kitchen, a bathroom and two bedrooms.

My favourite room is my bedroom because it's my own private space. After a long day, I can relax and feel comfortable there.

My bedroom is not very big, but it's very cozy. It has light blue walls. There's a comfortable bed, a small desk for my books and laptop, and a big window.

If I could make some changes, I would like to add more plants to make it even fresher. So, that's my bedroom - my favorite place in the house!

title: Topic 6: Shopping
prompts: Talk about the advantages of doing shopping in supermarkets or shopping malls.
- How are the prices?
- What about the quality of the goods?
- How is the atmosphere?
sampleAnswer:
I often go to Coomark supermarket at least once a week to buy food and other things for my family.

Because it sells everything I want and it is clean, cool and beautiful.

First, I think the prices are very stable. You can always see the prices clearly, and they don’t change much.

Second, the quality of products is usually high. They sell fresh food and good items, so you can trust that what you buy is safe for you and your family.

Third, the atmosphere is always nice. It’s clean, cool with air conditioning, and bright. There are also many cafés or places to eat, and sometimes even a cinema.

title: Topic 7: Food and drink
prompts: Talk about your favourite traditional food.
- What is your favourite traditional food?
- How to make it?
- Can you cook it well?
- How is it best served?
sampleAnswer:
My favourite food is Phở, which is a traditional Vietnamese noodle soup.

I like it because it has a rich and delicious broth, and the combination of soft noodles, tender beef or chicken, and fresh herbs makes it very tasty.

I can cook phở at home, but it takes a lot of time to prepare the broth properly. So, I usually buy it from local restaurants because they make it more professionally and it tastes better.

I eat phở about two or three times a week, especially for breakfast. It gives me enough energy to start my day.

title: Topic 8: Weather
prompts: Talk about your favourite season in the year.
- How many seasons are there in your region?
- What is your favourite season and when does it come?
- Why do you like it?
- And say what you like doing in this season.
sampleAnswer:
I live in Central Vietnam; there are four seasons in a year: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

My favourite season is autumn which lasts from July to September according to the lunar calendar.

I love autumn because of its perfect weather. Vietnam is very hot in summer, rainy in spring and dry in winter, but autumn is cool and beautiful sunshine.

I often like to spend time hanging out with my friends on the street while taking photos. Sometimes I go camping at Tuy Hoa beach with my friends.

title: Topic 9: Travel and transport
prompts: Talk about the advantages of public transport in big cities.
- What are social advantages of public transport?
- What are economic advantages of public transport?
- What are environmental advantages of public transport?
sampleAnswer: Public transport brings many advantages to big cities. Socially, it helps people travel safely and reduces traffic accidents. It also gives people a chance to read a book or relax while traveling. Economically, using public transport like buses or trains is much cheaper than driving a private car because you can save money on gas and parking fees. Environmentally, it helps reduce traffic jams and cuts down on air pollution, making the city greener and cleaner.

title: Topic 10: Health
prompts: Talk about the benefits of a healthy diet.
- What is a healthy diet?
- What are the benefits of a healthy diet?
- How could parents encourage their children to have a healthy diet?
sampleAnswer: A healthy diet is a balanced diet that includes a lot of vegetables, fruits, and fish, and avoids too much fast food, sugar, and fat. The benefits of a healthy diet are huge. It helps us stay fit, gives us more energy to work and study, and prevents dangerous diseases like obesity or heart problems. To encourage children to have a healthy diet, parents should be good role models by eating healthy food themselves and cooking delicious, nutritious meals at home.

title: Topic 11: Environment
prompts: Talk about environmental problems in your province/city.
- What are environmental problems?
- What are the causes?
- What are impacts of those environmental problems on community?
- What are solutions to those problems?
sampleAnswer: In my city, the two biggest environmental problems are air pollution and rubbish on the streets. The main causes are exhaust fumes from too many motorbikes and factories, and people's bad habit of throwing trash everywhere. These problems have negative impacts on our community. They make the city look ugly and cause many respiratory diseases for people. To solve these problems, the government should encourage people to use public transport, put more dustbins on the streets, and educate everyone to protect the environment.

title: Topic 12: Technology
prompts: Talk about the advantages of using the Internet.
- What are advantages of Internet for children?
- What are advantages of Internet for adults?
- What does Internet bring you?
sampleAnswer: The Internet has many great advantages. For children, it is a huge library where they can find information for their studies and play educational games. For adults, the Internet is a powerful tool for working, reading news, and shopping online. It also helps them connect with friends and partners all over the world. Personally, the Internet brings me a lot of joy and convenience. I use it every day to learn English, listen to music, and chat with my friends.
